prompts.background:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production BACKGROUND PLATE for a functioning layered 2.5D Salini Insight prototype. Generate one extremely refined photoreal architectural visualization, landscape 1536x1024. A small premium Italian mineral-cast sanitary ware factory inspection and packing bay, viewed from a LOCKED orthographic camera, elevation about 40 degrees, azimuth 45 degrees. Quiet substantial industrial architecture, NOT a cartoon, NOT a game low-poly asset, NOT a model made of toys. Real architectural materials, ray-traced bounced light, polished-but-not-mirror warm-gray concrete, brushed stainless steel, ivory ribbed walls, precise structural hardware, muted deep petrol machine bases, small safety amber accents. Rich microscopic surface detail, subtle wear only.
Composition: cutaway workshop occupying the middle of the frame, airy foreground floor. Back wall forms a shallow open L. A sophisticated stainless inspection station and instrument console at upper left. Shelves of cardboard shipping crates and a workbench at upper right; organized white basin and bathtub products at the rear bench ONLY. Service piping and ceiling beams at top. The middle third and lower middle must be an EMPTY CLEAR TRANSPORT AISLE, a broad concrete strip running diagonally from middle-left (x=350,y=480) toward lower-right (x=1150,y=820). Delicate lane boundaries follow that diagonal, no machines or inventory in it. We will move a separate cart down this aisle in software. Avoid anything crossing the empty lane. Air and negative space between workstations. A pair of potted ficus and a glass office edge at far right gives architectural context.
Soft daylight from upper-left, cool sky fill and warm practical task lighting. Ground shadows consistent and soft. Camera sees actual building scale, detailed fittings, small product shapes; no excessive close-up. Entire scene readable and beautiful as a wide 2:1 crop. Floor extends to the image edges, no floating platform. No people, no vehicles, no movable cargo in the aisle, no labels, no UI, no text, no logos, no baked path overlays, no artificial tilt-shift blur. This should feel like a $30k Corona/Cinema4D architectural render used as an executive operations tool.
prompts.carrier:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: one transparent moving sprite for a premium fixed-camera factory visualization. Reference image is LIGHTING, MATERIALS, CAMERA and SCALE reference only; do not include the room. Render a compact realistic industrial low-profile autonomous mobile robot, a flat rectangular dark petrol and brushed stainless steel cart, short wheelbase, four partly enclosed rubber wheels, precise industrial metal work, subtle small amber status beacon. On it is a neat protective foam cradle holding TWO sculptural white mineral-cast countertop washbasins with softly rounded rectangular geometry, consistent with the sanitary ware visible in the workshop. No driver, no person, no text, no logos. This is a serious factory transport unit, not a cute robot.
Camera: EXACTLY match the workshop reference looking down 40 degrees. The LENGTH of the cart aligns with the workshop diagonal aisle running from TOP LEFT toward BOTTOM RIGHT on screen, approximately 32 degrees downward right. Cart's forward end faces bottom right. Show top and the two relevant side faces as in the reference. Do NOT face bottom left. Warm soft light from upper left, neutral diffuse sky fill, physically rendered gentle specular highlights, NOT glossy plastic.
One single complete object, centered with 10% transparent padding, full undercarriage visible. NO ground plane, NO room, NO shadow baked outside silhouette (contact shadow is rendered separately in app), NO gray matte, truly transparent background. Maximum refinement and photorealism as a Corona renderer compositing layer. 1024 square.
prompts.worker:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: photoreal sprite atlas for a fixed-camera Salini factory animation. Reference image is only the camera, lighting and architectural-material reference. Render ONE consistent factory quality technician shown in EIGHT successive poses of ONE full WALK cycle, neatly arranged in an exact 4-column by 2-row atlas. Each cell equal size, all figures the SAME scale and aligned at the feet. Entire image 1536x1024. Truly TRANSPARENT background in every cell; no grid or titles, no letters, no numbers, no shadows outside silhouettes, no contact sheet borders.
The adult technician wears a sophisticated dark petrol work jacket, charcoal trousers, dark work boots and a white safety helmet, no luminous vest. They WALK toward bottom-right of the image, along the reference aisle direction, about 32 degrees downward-right projected direction. Camera looks down at 40 degrees, the same camera as the workshop. Never look at camera. Arms swing naturally, legs anatomically correct, eight progressive different frames: right foot contact, right leg down, left leg passes, right heel rises, left foot contact, left leg down, right leg passes, left heel rises. This is ONE coherent 8-frame walk cycle, not 8 different people or views. No tools, no products or machines in their hands. Real cloth folds, realistic tiny features, dimensional correct body, soft daylight from upper-left matching room. High-end architectural visualisation quality, no cartoon. Full body fits each cell with comfortable transparent margins. Exactly 8 whole figures; all cropped neither head nor feet.
